faq.q: Do I need a licence to charter a yacht in Marbella in 2038?
faq.a: No, you do not need a licence for a skippered charter. All our boats come with a licensed skipper who handles navigation. If you want a bareboat charter (self-drive), you must hold a valid ICC or equivalent Spanish licence. We only offer skippered charters.

faq.q: What is the ICC and is it accepted in Spain?
faq.a: The International Certificate of Competence (ICC) is a recognised qualification for recreational boaters. Spain accepts ICCs issued by countries party to the UNECE Resolution 40, plus most EU states. For non-EU visitors, a valid national licence with an official translation may be accepted.

faq.q: Can I rent a boat without a skipper in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, but only for small boats under 6m and limited power. For larger vessels (like our fleet from 6.4m to 29m), Spanish law requires a licensed skipper for charter operations. We provide a professional skipper on every charter, so you don't need a licence.

faq.q: What documents do I need to bring for a skippered charter?
faq.a: You only need a valid passport or ID card. No boating licence, no sailing experience required. Just show up at Puerto Banús, meet your skipper, and enjoy the day. We handle all paperwork and insurance.

faq.q: Are there any age restrictions for passengers?
faq.a: There are no minimum age restrictions for passengers. Children are welcome on all our boats. Life jackets are provided for all sizes. The skipper is responsible for safety and can advise on suitable activities for kids.

faq.q: What happens if I have a licence but want to drive?
faq.a: Even if you hold a valid ICC, our skippered charters include a skipper who retains ultimate control. You may be allowed to take the helm under supervision, but the skipper remains legally responsible. For full self-drive, you'd need a bareboat charter (not offered by us).

faq.q: Do I need insurance for a yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: No, all our charters include full insurance cover (third-party liability and passenger accident insurance) as part of the package. You don't need to arrange separate insurance. Just relax and enjoy the trip.

faq.q: How do I book a skippered yacht charter without a licence?
faq.a: Simply contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, boat, and duration. We'll confirm availability and send you a booking link. No licence checks, no paperwork. Payment can be made by bank transfer or card. Your skipper will meet you at Puerto Banús.

data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella yacht charter in 2038? The good news: you don't need a licence for the vast majority of charters. Spanish maritime law requires a licensed skipper for any commercial charter vessel over 6 metres, and all our boats – from the 6.4m Mariah SX21 to the 29m Ferretti 94 – come with a professional skipper included. That means zero licence requirements for you. Just bring your passport and a sense of adventure.

This guide explains the Marbella yacht charter license requirements 2038, what documents you need, and how to book a stress-free day on the water from Puerto Banús.

Do You Need a Licence for a Marbella Yacht Charter in 2038?

If you book a skippered charter – which is what we offer – the answer is no. The skipper holds a valid Spanish or internationally recognised licence (e.g., ICC, RYA Yachtmaster, or Spanish PER). You are a passenger. No licence, no experience, no problem.

For bareboat charters (self-drive), you would need a valid ICC or equivalent. But we do not offer bareboat hire. Every boat in our fleet departs from Puerto Banús with a licensed skipper who handles navigation, mooring, and safety. This is the simplest, safest way to enjoy the Costa del Sol.

What Licences Are Accepted for Skippered Charters?

Since you don't need a licence, this question is moot for passengers. However, our skippers hold one of the following:

  • Spanish PER (Patrón de Embarcaciones de Recreo) – valid for vessels up to 24m.
  • RYA Yachtmaster Coastal or Offshore – internationally recognised.
  • ICC (International Certificate of Competence) – accepted in Spanish waters.

All skippers are experienced, insured, and familiar with local waters from Marbella to Estepona and Sotogrande.

What Documents Do You Need to Bring?

For a skippered charter, you only need:

  • A valid passport or national ID card (for EU citizens).
  • No boating licence.
  • No sailing certificate.
  • No insurance documents (we include full cover).

Children are welcome; life jackets are provided. The skipper will brief you on safety procedures before departure.

Bareboat vs Skippered: What's the Difference?

For 99% of visitors, a skippered charter is the best choice. You relax, enjoy the views of La Concha, swim at Cala del Faro, or anchor off the Golden Mile, while the skipper handles everything.

Our Fleet: No Licence Needed, Just Choose Your Boat

We operate 20+ boats from Puerto Banús, all skippered. Here are popular options:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h, €2,299/8h.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – same pricing.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719 minimum 4h, includes free jet ski.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – pricing on request.
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) – ideal for a quick spin.

All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava), light snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. No hidden costs.

How to Book a Skippered Charter in Marbella

Booking is simple: contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, boat, and duration. We'll confirm availability and send a payment link. No licence checks, no paperwork. Your skipper will meet you at the Boat Rental Marbella office in Puerto Banús. From there, you can cruise to Cabopino, Estepona, or even Sotogrande for lunch.

Prices are transparent: Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours, up to €2,299 for a full day (8h). Tier B (Mangusta 80) is €4,719 minimum 4h. Other boats: enquire via WhatsApp.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a licence to charter a yacht in Marbella in 2038?

No, you do not need a licence for a skippered charter. All our boats come with a licensed skipper who handles navigation. If you want a bareboat charter (self-drive), you must hold a valid ICC or equivalent Spanish licence. We only offer skippered charters.

What is the ICC and is it accepted in Spain?

The International Certificate of Competence (ICC) is a recognised qualification for recreational boaters. Spain accepts ICCs issued by countries party to the UNECE Resolution 40, plus most EU states. For non-EU visitors, a valid national licence with an official translation may be accepted.

Can I rent a boat without a skipper in Marbella?

Yes, but only for small boats under 6m and limited power. For larger vessels (like our fleet from 6.4m to 29m), Spanish law requires a licensed skipper for charter operations. We provide a professional skipper on every charter, so you don't need a licence.

What documents do I need to bring for a skippered charter?

You only need a valid passport or ID card. No boating licence, no sailing experience required. Just show up at Puerto Banús, meet your skipper, and enjoy the day. We handle all paperwork and insurance.

Are there any age restrictions for passengers?

There are no minimum age restrictions for passengers. Children are welcome on all our boats. Life jackets are provided for all sizes. The skipper is responsible for safety and can advise on suitable activities for kids.

What happens if I have a licence but want to drive?

Even if you hold a valid ICC, our skippered charters include a skipper who retains ultimate control. You may be allowed to take the helm under supervision, but the skipper remains legally responsible. For full self-drive, you'd need a bareboat charter (not offered by us).

Do I need insurance for a yacht charter in Marbella?

No, all our charters include full insurance cover (third-party liability and passenger accident insurance) as part of the package. You don't need to arrange separate insurance. Just relax and enjoy the trip.

How do I book a skippered yacht charter without a licence?

Simply contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, boat, and duration. We'll confirm availability and send you a booking link. No licence checks, no paperwork. Payment can be made by bank transfer or card. Your skipper will meet you at Puerto Banús.
